description: Parkings sur Rennes Métropole is a dataset listed in Rennes-metropole open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Rennes Métropole - Direction de la Voirie - Services généraux Patrimoine. Cette couche localise les parkings référencés par le Service Mobilité Urbaine (SMU) et la Direction de la voirie sur le territoire de Rennes Métropole. Coverage: Rennes Métropole. The portal files it under Mobilité, Transport. Its keywords are parc de stationnement. The portal shows 4,416 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2023-10-10 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence ODbL 1.0 (http://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-rennesmetropole-fr-portal.
